topic: The Mathematical Trinity: Powers, Roots, and Logarithms

sections.title: The Bridge: Prerequisite Recap
lecture_lines: Imagine a seed growing into a tree.
The base is our starting seed.
The exponent is our growth time.
The result is the final height.
Two raised to three equals eight. [Asset: growth_tree_animation]
animations: Fade out title, show seed mobject in #00FF00.
Display exponent "t" next to seed in #FFCC00.
Flash result "8" and seed "2^3=8" to emphasize.

sections.title: Roots: Finding the Seed
lecture_lines: Now, let's reverse the growth process.
We look to find the seed.
This is the root operation.
The cube root of eight is two. [Asset: rewind_tree_animation]
animations: Fade out title, show cube mobject in #00FF00.

sections.title: Logarithms: Finding the Time
lecture_lines: Logarithms tell us the time passed.
We measure how long it grew.
Log base two of eight is three. [Asset: stopwatch_animation]
animations: Fade out title, show stopwatch mobject in #00FFFF.

sections.title: Unified Notation: The Magic Triangle
lecture_lines: These are three parts of one story.
Powers, roots, and logarithms unite.
Base, exponent, result form a triangle.
We slide the dial to transform equations.
All expressions describe the same truth. [Asset: triangle_animation]
animations: Fade out title, draw equilateral triangle.
Place "base" at vertex 1, "exp" at vertex 2, "result" at vertex 3 in #FFFFFF.
Animate sliding dial showing transformation equations.
Flash the whole triangle to show connectivity.

sections.title: Application: The Astronaut's Fuel
lecture_lines: Rockets use this to track fuel.
We solve for time using logs.
Math fuels our journey through space. [Asset: rocket_fuel_animation]
animations: Fade out title, show rocket mobject in #FF4500.
Show log equation tracking fuel over time.
